digest.component_or_area: CLI search command and library search interface
propositions: rebar search returns full ticket bodies (description and all comments) instead of discovery summaries, exhausting agent context for queries like SupportsIncremental (~203 KB)
No --output flag is recognized by rebar search; --output json exits with code 2 and is not treated as query text

Default search lacks a bounded summary field (240 character max, falling back to normalized description when stored summary is absent) and case-preserving snippet extraction centered on first matching term
MCP and CLI search return the same verbose TicketState schema; need dedicated SearchResult and SearchResult_LLM schemas with minimal discovery fields
rebar search --full must preserve legacy full-state JSON for migration; rebar search --full --output=llm must reject incompatibly
Library overload of rebar.search must distinguish full=False returning SearchResult from full=True returning TicketState for type safety
